home.headline: Deniz Zeybek
home.intro: Most of my work has been analytics dashboards, a component library three products were rebuilt on, and a Vue 2 to Vue 3 migration that ran while the roadmap kept moving.
home.agents: Since 2025 I work with coding agents every day, and it changed how I set a project up before the first feature: a generated API client, a strict compiler, and conventions written where an agent can read them.
home.nda: Almost everything I have shipped sits behind an NDA, so there is no gallery here. What I think is in the {notes}.
home.roleLine: Software developer, mainly frontend — TypeScript across the stack, six years shipping production web apps at enterprise scale.
home.facts: I am based in Turkey on GMT+3 and work remotely only, worldwide or across EMEA, contract or full-time. Computer Engineering degree from Muğla University, professional English, native Turkish. Deepest on Vue 3, Nuxt and TypeScript; hands-on with React and React Native; comfortable owning the Node and NestJS side of a feature rather than handing it over at the API.
